title: Universal rank-one kernels split the first differential
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and P a cochain complex of R-modules (modules P^i with differentials d^i: P^i -> P^(i+1) and d^(i+1) d^i = 0). Suppose P^(-1) = 0 and P^0 and P^1 are finite projective (finitely generated direct summands of free modules). For every commutative R-algebra B, suppose H^0(P tensor_R B), the kernel of its degree-zero differential modulo the image of its degree-minus-one differential, is isomorphic to B. Then there exists an R-linear map s: P^1 -> P^0 such that d^0 s d^0 = d^0. There is no boundedness hypothesis and no finiteness or projectivity assumption on the other terms.

source.place: Tags 00O0 (unit-minor reduction of finite projective maps), 00NX (finite presentation and local projectivity); fixed-affine adaptation of the degree-zero splitting argument

proof.text: Apply universalH0_split_factorization with the unchanged hypotheses, obtaining d=e p, r e=id_I and p q=id_I. Set s=q r. Then d s d=e(p q)(r e)p=e p=d, by associativity and the two splitting equations.

theorem universalH0_split_differential
    (R : Type v) [CommRing R]
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) ℤ)
    (hf0 : Module.Finite R (P.X 0))
    (hf1 : Module.Finite R (P.X 1))
    (hp0 : Module.Projective R (P.X 0))
    (hp1 : Module.Projective R (P.X 1))
    (hneg : IsZero (P.X (-1)))
    (hzero : ∀ (B : Type v) [CommRing B] (φ : R →+* B),
      let PB := ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
      Nonempty (PB.homology 0 ≅ ModuleCat.of B B)) :
    ∃ s : P.X 1 ⟶ P.X 0, P.d 0 1 ≫ s ≫ P.d 0 1 = P.d 0 1
